AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: DeDup finds and cleans up duplicate photos/videos, large files, and junk on the device. Operational Patterns: - Use 'findLargeFiles' to find the largest photos/videos/audio files on the device, optionally filtered by a minimum size. - Use 'findOldPhotos' to find photos added more than a given number of days ago, oldest first. - Use 'getStorageSummary' to get a per-media-type breakdown of file count and total size on the device. Constraints: - All exposed functions are read-only; DeDup does not expose file deletion to agents.
